evidence.detail: rs/g has two static dump overloads accepting byte[] or int[] pixel buffers plus width/height/name. Both build a BufferedImage, copy every pixel with setRGB, and write the result through ImageIO.write(..., "png", file).
The class has a constant output root "./tests/" and constructs files as "./tests/<name>.png".
The class prints the surviving diagnostic "Dumped image to: <absolute path>" after preparing the target file.

proposals.note: ImageDumper is a conservative semantic recovery name for the exact v308 PNG test-image export utility; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
